direction: Island HVAC shop with no website: type-and-color only (no logo, no photos). Lake Washington teal against furnace ember on warm paper, editorial serif display.
hero_idea: Oversized serif list of plain-language problems (heat out, AC won't cool, new system, tune-up); tapping one fills the service ticket and jumps to it
scroll_story: A day on the island: the page background drifts from morning lake fog to noon paper to evening dusk as you scroll
custom_ui: Service ticket builder (system / job / building / where) that texts the ticket to the shop
Service area strip: Mercer Island → King County → Kitsap County, each with a schematic map lighting that region
